sources.sourceName: O*NET 27.2 Database (U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration)
sources.notes: Authoritative U.S. occupational information. Provided complete skills (importance ratings), knowledge areas, task statements, technology skills (hot/in-demand flags), alternate titles, education, and job zones for canonical O*NET-SOC codes. Primary Tier-1 backbone for all roles.

European Skills/Competences/Qualifications and Occupations framework. Occupation + skill-relation CSVs obtained via the public tabiya-tech GitHub mirror (github.com/tabiya-tech/tabiya-esco-datasets-and-tools, datasets/tabiya/esco-v1.1.1/csv). Used for European-aligned essential/optional skill evidence. Occupation codes: data analyst 2511.3, web developer 2513.5, software developer 2512.4, data scientist 2511.4, ICT intelligent systems designer 2511.11, ICT system developer 2511.15.

Public, no-authentication job-postings API. Provided 239 raw postings (192 after de-duplication) across the five target roles. Used to compute market skill frequency (jobPostingCount / marketFrequency). Sample skews toward remote and junior/intern listings.
Public job-postings API (100 listings retrieved). Used as a secondary, independent market source to cross-validate demand signals and reduce single-source bias.
